facts.statement: The frozen Chess command-list workload completed the captured driver-reachable firmware sequence inside the vfio-user emulator and produced the ordered 2 through 65 result.
preconditions: The captured Phoenix firmware payload has SHA-256 d13ff9fb95c6cea40213fa69e5a3465529f00bb67c0984d62343c6e31808fb9e.
The captured amdxdna source is commit 216cefececd74effcd7a88350c71b99f5ef9a215.
The guest uses the frozen Chess add_one_using_dma workload with force_cmdlist=Y and tdr_timeout_ms=0.
initial_state: A fresh QEMU invocation exposes emulated PCI identity 1022:1502.
The guest has no vIOMMU, force_iova=N, and a 256 MiB carveout beginning at 0x60000000.
stimulus: Run test.exe -x aie.xclbin -k MLIR_AIE -i insts.bin through the normal XRT and amdxdna path.
external_events: The vfio-user model services the management mailbox and context MSI-X interrupts.
facts.expected_transition: firmware query -> context create -> host-buffer map -> CU config -> CHAIN_EXEC_NPU -> context MSI-X acknowledgement -> context destroy
expected_outputs: The command-list completion status is zero; failure-index response words remain unknown.
The guest prints every integer from 2 through 65 in order, then PASS! and PHOENIX_FROZEN_PASS chess.
ordering: Context creation and host-buffer/CU configuration precede CHAIN_EXEC_NPU.
The context MSI-X acknowledgement follows command submission and precedes context destroy.
timing_bounds: No physical or cycle-level timing bound is established by this legacy capture.
remaining_unknowns: Agreement with the owned physical NPU1 and its physical PCI/MSI-X topology.

facts.statement: On the pinned physical Phoenix NPU1 tuple, the frozen Chess add_one_using_dma workload completed both the direct EXECUTE_BUFFER_CF control path and the CHAIN_EXEC_NPU treatment path with zero host-observed execute status and identical ordered output 2 through 65.
preconditions: The physical NPU runs firmware amdnpu/1502_00/npu.dev.sbin with SHA-256 d13ff9fb95c6cea40213fa69e5a3465529f00bb67c0984d62343c6e31808fb9e.

The loaded candidate amdxdna module is built from commit 216cefececd74effcd7a88350c71b99f5ef9a215, has SHA-256 a0f8ae51f67fd0fa43accf9b13f99b2c5165e72c2b3a9f10c08160914e443093, and reports srcversion EF2F7855FE7AB3600D4DFA7.
Both runs use the same frozen Chess aie.xclbin, insts.bin, and test.exe fixtures through XRT on physical NPU1.
initial_state: The device is physical PCI function 0000:c6:00.1 with identity 1022:1502, revision 00, and subsystem f111:0005.
The campaign begins in a fresh candidate-module epoch with zero active NPU clients, tdr_timeout_ms=2000, and force_cmdlist initially Y.
The device is in PCI D0 with power/control pinned on for both runs.
stimulus: Run the frozen workload once with force_cmdlist=N to select EXECUTE_BUFFER_CF opcode 0x0c, then once with force_cmdlist=Y to select CHAIN_EXEC_NPU opcode 0x18.
external_events: No deliberate external event or recovery action occurs during either run; the normal driver, firmware, interrupt, and fence lifecycle proceeds.
facts.expected_transition: common physical context create -> host-buffer map -> CU config -> EXECUTE_BUFFER_CF 0x0c control or CHAIN_EXEC_NPU 0x18 treatment -> response, interrupt, and fence completion -> context destroy
expected_outputs: Both runs report host-observed execute status zero.
Both runs print every integer from 2 through 65 in order and PASS!.
Both runs add zero attributable TDRs and zero IOMMU faults, complete clean teardown, and restore capture instrumentation.
ordering: The control run completes before the treatment run in the same loaded-module epoch.
Context creation, host-buffer mapping, and CU configuration precede execution; response, interrupt, and fence completion precede context destroy.
timing_bounds: Recorded host command durations are 116599697 ns for the control and 215538268 ns for the treatment; these observations establish no firmware, NPU-cycle, or clock-domain timing bound.
alternatives_ruled_out: Success is not unique to CHAIN_EXEC_NPU: the paired EXECUTE_BUFFER_CF control produces the same output and host-observed completion status.
remaining_unknowns: The complete CONFIG_CU and CHAIN_EXEC_NPU success-response payload semantics, including failure-index words.
Generalization to other kernels, compiler outputs, firmware versions, devices, and development-only operations.
Determinism and timing across repeated identical launches.
Preemption, cancellation, timeout, fault recovery, and lifecycle resilience.

Cycle, clock-domain, latency, and causal timing behavior.
